    c.commregistry AS communication_registry,
    c.vpnflag AS vpn_usage,
    c.langpattern AS language_pattern,
    c.msgtally AS message_count,

    communication AS c

    riskanalysis AS r ON c.commregistry = r.commref

SELECT 
    c.commregistry AS communication_registry,
    c.vpnflag AS vpn_usage,
    c.langpattern AS language_pattern,
    c.msgtally AS message_count,
    (r.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT AS communication_risk,
    CASE 
        WHEN (r.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT = 'High-risk' THEN 'Deceptive Pattern' 
        WHEN (r.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT = 'Normal' THEN 'Normal Pattern' 
        ELSE 'Deceptive Pattern' 
    END AS pattern
FROM 
    communication AS c
JOIN 
    riskanalysis AS r ON c.commregistry = r.commref
ORDER BY 
    communication_registry;
